Product Features

  • Perfect dimensions for common living rooms: The TV cabinet measures 180 × 40 × 50 cm and offers enough space for TVs up to 75 inches without taking up too much space.
  • Natural wood look with modern black contrast: The cabinet in a warm wood look combined with black accents fits modern, Scandinavian and industrial interior styles.
  • Versatile Storage Solution: With two doors, two drawers and open shelves, the cabinet offers space for DVDs, game consoles and decorations.
  • Robust construction made of high-quality chipboard: The body is made of durable chipboard material, is dimensionally stable and easy to clean.
  • Sturdy metal legs for a secure stand: The black metal legs ensure high stability and give the lowboard a modern look.
  • Safe load capacity up to 30 kg: The TV cabinet is designed for a maximum load of 30 kg and can also reliably withstand larger TVs.
  • Noiseless hinges & smooth-running rails: The doors and drawers open and close smoothly and silently, for comfortable everyday use.
  • Practical cable grommets: The integrated cable grommets keep things tidy and hide unsightly cables inside the cabinet.
  • Easy assembly & versatile use: The lowboard is quick to assemble and is also suitable as a sideboard or storage cabinet in the dining room or hallway.
  • Due to light and monitor settings, the actual color of the product may be slightly different from the picture. The article received is decisive.

Descriptions

Describe

Measuring 180 × 40 × 50 cm, this modern TV cabinet combines a natural wood look with black accents and fits perfectly into any living room. Made of sturdy chipboard and sturdy metal legs, it can withstand up to 30kg and offers versatile storage through doors, drawers and open shelves. Noiseless hinges, smooth-running rails and integrated cable grommets ensure comfortable use and order – a stylish and practical focal point for your living area.
